# saas-landing-ref — Source Note

The spec referenced a `skills/saas-landing/` directory in open-design, which does not exist.
Instead, we extracted `skills/ui-ux-pro-max/` (the UX pattern library skill) as the
closest concrete SaaS landing reference available in this repo.

The upstream data lives at: https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill
The locally-installed copy is at: ~/.claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/data/
